preconditions.description: The number of operations n must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 for t in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation type t must be between 1 and 3.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= len(sequence) for a, _ in add_operations)
preconditions.description: For add operations, a must be within the bounds of the current sequence length.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= x <= 1000 for _, x in add_operations)
preconditions.description: For add operations, x must be within the range -1000 to 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= k <= 1000 for k in append_operations)
preconditions.description: For append operations, k must be within the range -1000 to 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, one for each operation.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(output[i] - expected_average[i]) < 1e-6 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output averages must match the expected averages with an absolute or relative error of at most 1e-6.

invariants.description: The sequence must always contain at least one element.
The average of the sequence must be correctly calculated and stored in the output.
